Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 813 (Fu Shing KTR Station Stop). While reserved platforms for Eastcoast Line are seen at this station, it is unlikely that Eastcoast Line would ever be put in use due to changes in development plans.

Fun Facts[]

  • During the planning stages of this station, this station was named Callisto Station, named after Callisto, one of the moons of Jupiter. However, to avoid confusion with Io and Europa, the name of this place and this station have been modified.
  • While Galaxy would also be a viable translation of the Chinese Name of this station, if Galaxy had been used, the Chinese name of this station would have been different.[2]
  • While Milky Way is also a viable translation of the Chinese Name of this station, as per the request from the developer of Jupiter, and as there is a river nearby, River has to be used as the station name, and the word Galactic stems from the grayish color that is usually depicted in the Milky Way, hence the Milky Way Station Art at the concourse of this station. Nonetheless, due to translation errors, the word Galaxy still appeared at Exits A, B, and D of this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Chinese Name of this station has undergone changes, and the English Name of this Station pays tribute to Galileo Galilei.[4]
  • As this Station is considered a Rural Station, the Concourse only occupies 60% of the length of the Platform.
  • The Entirety of this station is constructed off the coast of TriPaw in a fashion similar to Top Hill Bay Station.

History[]

  • March 26 2022: This Station completed Structural Works.[5]
  • March 27 2022: This Station began services.
  • August 1 2022: This station is chosen as the venue for the Project Nazca tenth anniversary Photoshoot.

title: Gateway
safeHtml:
Gateway (Referred to as "Gwy" in this wiki) is a Station Class in Los Sengas. It is a class below Terminals, and is followed by Checkpoints. This station class is only applicable for Nazca Railway, and currently there are 8 "Gateway-class" stations. All "Group 1" Gateway Stations make use of a unique Platform Screen Door color,[1] whereas all existing "Group 2" Gateway Stations make use of unique glass colors next to the track.

It should also be noted that all Gateway Stations are designed to be located at a 20-km, a 50-km or a 100-km radius from Metropolis Terminal, with the Terminal being at the center of the radius.

Contents

  • 1 Definition and Characteristics of Gateways
  • 2 List of Stations
    • 2.1 Nazca Railway
      • 2.1.1 Group 1
      • 2.1.2 Group 2
  • 3 Citations and References

Definition and Characteristics of Gateways[]

Gateway Stations are designed to be located at the east, south, west, north, north-west, south-west, north-east and south-east, at around 20-km, 50-km or 100-km radius away from the center point (Metropolis Terminal), meaning that there will only be 24 stations to be defined as Gateway. Currently, NR has separated the eight built or to-be-built gateways into two groups, and each group of Gateways has their own set of specific names.

There are some glasses inside each group of Gateways that are painted with the Gateway's respective colors. Group 1 Gateways have these colored glasses installed on platform screen doors, while Group 2 Gateways have these glasses installed behind the tracks.

List of Stations[]

Nazca Railway[]

Nazca Railway currently has built and are building two groups of Gateways, including,

Group 1[]

Located 20-km away from center point in the east/south/west/north directions, named with "Intus" plus its relative direction:

  • Stadium Line, Xofa Line Intus Occident Gateway
  • Stadium Line, Bravo Line Intus Orient Gateway
  • Urban Line, Urban Express, Snowty Line, Mike Line Intus Aquilo Gateway
  • Urban Line, Urban Express Intus Austrum Gateway

Group 2[]

Located 20-km away from center point in the north-west/south-west/north-east/south-east directions, named with Seasons plus "Point":

  • Arcgo Line, Phoenix Line, Golf Line Fall Point Gateway
  • Akashi Line, Southern Corridor, Southern Corridor Rapid, Vision Line Summer Point Gateway
  • Ingress Line, Asylum Line, Snowty Line, Rover Line, Charlie Line, Mike Line Winter Point Gateway
  • Oasis Bay Line, Daybreaker Line, Starshore Line, Union Circular, Echo Line, Kilo Line Spring Point Gateway[2][3]

Citations and References[]

  2. ↑ https://youtu.be/SXlDmXTRMZQ?t=1874
  3. ↑ Reference to Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition Part II and Official Discord Announcements.

title: General Electric Railway
safeHtml:
General Electric Railway is a railway alliance consisted of Nawis Railway, Cities Transport Railway Division, Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu and PTT. Railway.

Contents

History[]

  • March 2022: The Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme entered the "Continuous Development" phase and no longer operated based on periods. In order to facilitate collaboration between different railway companies, Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu (Then named Mass Transport Railway System Company) has decided to propose a merger with Nawis Railway and Cities Transport Railway Division so that, in the event of a player leaving the server, the handover to them will be smoother.

This plan was initially accepted by the remaining two companies. However, since the direct merger of the three railway companies would be detrimental to the future development of the railway, they agreed to form a railway alliance instead, and other railway companies are welcome to join.

  • March 26 2022: PTT. Railway was established and joined this alliance.
  • June 28 2023: Mass Transport Railway System Company is renamed Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu.
  • July 3 2023: Kirameki Electric Railway joined this alliance

Gentle Island Station is a station on East Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Cometsilk. Passengers may also use this station to change to Creeper Railway Pure Water Line (Gentle Island Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station was formerly located on an island, hence its name and its narrow concourse width.
  • While it was unclear why Light Gray Wool was used at this station, as this station was built with the themes of "Gentle" and "Literature" in mind, a two-storey Bookshelf is set up next to the Los Sengas Coffee of this station. Moreover, the Chairs of the Platforms in this station also feature bookshelves.
  • This station is the first of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate a math teacher who taught Railway Builder for a year at SKH Chan Young Secondary School, with the other two stations being Harvest River Station and Virtel Heights Station.[2][3]

History[]

  • September 8 2017: This Station completed construction.[4]
  • September 9 2017: This station began services.

This route is represented by Light Green Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 16.

Glacier Express is the proposed Express Line of Glacier Line. Similar to Urban Express, this line also uses the letter "X" to represent "Express". It is known that this line will stop at Glacier Station, Quinty Station, Snowty North Station, Arctic Sea Station, Glaciss Station and Coopol Station, but it is unknown when this line will start services.

Line Characteristics[]

Main Line (Glacier Line)[]

  • One of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. Mainly serves the west, central and northwest areas of Ingress Continent.
  • The section between Causeway Bay Station and Qoser Coast Station uses Oceanfloor Tunnels. This line is the fourth line to adopt such a tunnel design.[1]
  • This line is the second line to adopt a "Bridge Core" design after Oasis Bay Line.
  • All stations along this line uses Liquid Platform Screen Doors and glass floors.
  • This line was formerly the line that took the longest to extend given that the line has plans to extend (From the establishment of this line on December 16 2016 until its extension to Causeway Bay Station on October 25 2020, this line took 3 years and 10 months before it begun extension). However, this record was broken by Ingress Line on March 3 2022 (This line has not extended by any means since it reached Chilly Canyon Station on April 3 2018).

Express Line (Glacier Express)[]

  • This line will become the express service of Glacier Line in the future.
  • All known stops of Glacier Express are interchanges.

Fun Facts[]

  • Originally, parts of the announcement for Glacier Line has a higher pitch than that of other lines. This was used as a refernce for the MTR South Island Line having higher-pitched announcements.
  • Glacier Line used to be the shortest line in Nazca Railway, running only between Glacier Station and Ingress Flatland Station. Later, it became the line will the most stations added in one single episode, at 17 stations in S3E13P1.
  • The ruralness of the districts served by Glacier Line meant that this line, from its commencement of services in 2016 until the establishment of Snowty Line and Mike Line in 2023, could only interchange with Flask Line at Glacier Station. This causes Glacier Line to be one of the most marginalized lines. However, this situation was alleviated as Snowty Line and Mike Line were established and reached Quinty Station. In the future, Glacier Line will feature more interchanges with other lines.

Future Development[]

  • This station will be the southbound Terminus of Glacier Express in the future.

Fun Facts[]

  • Before the extension of Flask Line to Peacean Island Station, this station was the termini of both Flask Line and Glacier Line. The arrangement of transfering trains at this station alluded to the Lower Platforms of Tiu Keng Leng Station.

History[]

  • December 12 2016: This station completed construction.[3]
  • December 13 2016: This station began services alongside Flask Line, but Glacier Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • December 16 2016: Glacier Line is established.
  • January 2 2017: Issues with high-pitched Glacier Line announcements have been resolved.[4]
  • July 7 2018: Glacier Station Destruction Incident:
    • Due to misuse of commands from an administrator,[5] this station was closed for more than three hours. During that time period, Glacier Line services were suspended, and Flask Line terminates at Spike End Station.[6]In the incident, more than a dozen players went to that station to see the progress of recovery until the administrator involved in that incident expelled the players. 20 minutes after the incident, Nazca Railway had written a notice, and at 1am, the administrator involved also wrote a letter of apology. Currently, the station has recovered.[7]
  • July 8 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[8]

Glaciss Station is a station on Glacier Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Coopol. This station will serve Glacier Express and Ingress Line in the future, and passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 3111 (Glaciss NR Station Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that Glacier Line and Ingress Line will meet here.
  • The Transfer Concourse of this station alludes to that of Snipe Valley Station, whereas the Concourse of this station alludes to that of Cooace Hill Station.
  • Being the 333rd Station, this station is the third station to feature three digits of a single number, with the first two being Purple Gate Station and Longwington Station.

History[]

  • December 17 2020: This station began services alongside Glacier Line, but Glacier Express and Ingress Line Platforms remain reserved.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Oriel Gyre.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Where Cold Order Moves and Night Becomes String".

Fun Facts[]

  • The East end of the Station Concourse also serves as a Public Passage between Exits A and B. When the Station closes down, Exits A and B would still remain open.
  • This Station features a memorial dedicated to the deceased civilians and firefighters in the Wang Fuk Court Fire.

History[]

  • November 25 2025: This Station began construction.
  • November 27 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • November 28 2025: This station began services.

Glinstrouß Line is Line Number 23 of NR Los Sengas Division Standard Railway. This line has 10 stations, and was established on July 16 2021. It runs between Bulbacon and Arcgo West Island.

Description[]

Glinstrouß Line is one of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along Peckern North, and will extend to the east and the west in the future.

This route is represented by Spring Green Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 23.

History[]

Origins[]

This line was first proposed by the developers in Peckern North at the end of 2018. Initial plans of this line involves a route highly similar to the current route, with the main purpose of this line being connecting Arcgo Line and Daring Line together. Earliest plans of this line involved direct connections to the large construction project in East Dansein. However, due to changes in development plans, this plan was scrapped in 2020 and the connect was instead planned as a branch line.

Development Chapters[]

  • S3E14P2: Bulbacon - Halcedon
  • S3E19: Bulbacon - Arcgo West Island

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Northeast from Dansein Market Station to Halcedon Station. Completed
(Chapter: S3E14P2)
Extend further Northeast from Halcedon Station to the Northeast of Peckern North, where it interchanges with different new lines or existing line extensions.[1] Completed
(Chapter: S3E19)
Down Extend Westwards from the Zero Station of Dansein Market Station to Bulbacon Station at the west of Tin Kum-Shek Pai Tau New Town, acting as the connecting line between Arcgo Line and Daring Line in the process. This is the first section of this line. Completed
(Chapter: S3E14P2)
Extend from Bulbacon Station to the Northwest of Peckern Continent. TBC

Districts Served[]

  • Peckern North
    • Arcgo West Island

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. This line currently mainly serves Peckern North. Subsequent development saw this line extend to the north and northwest of that district.
  • This line is the first line to connect two previously unconnected Nazca Railway systems within Peckern North.[2]
  • It took two and a half years for this line to go from the planning process to the construction process, with the reconstruction of Shek Pai Tau happening within this timespan.
  • Phase I of this line mostly passes through developed areas, but as plans kept on varying before the establishment of this line, discussions regarding this line had sparked discussion, including but not limited to:
    • The construction of this line being foreshadowed in Dansein Market Station.
    • The name of the station linked to the construction project in East Dansein.
    • The route of the line between Bondhill Curves and Tin Kam.
    • The structure of Tin Kam Station, and:
    • The final name of Bulbacon.
  • This line is the sister line of Prospektious Line, which also serves Peckern North.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line may extend to Poon Tong Station of Phoenix Line in the future.

Fun Facts[]

  • Due to the requirements from the Jupiter developer, the exits extend a long distance from this station. As a result, the In-Station transit of this station has four stations instead of two.[2] In total, the In-Station Transit is 710m long.[3]
  • At the Exit Passageways, the blocks of gold on the floor leads to the Station Concourse. A similar system is also used at Dul-las Station.

History[]

  • April 22 2022: The Goalkeep Corner In-Station Transit completed construction.[4]
  • April 23 2022: This Station began services.

Golf Line is one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along the northwest of Sava, before proceeding along the south coast of Odyssey and into Peckern North.

Description[]

Gondola Line is one of the Auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along West Metropolis Archipelago.

This route is represented by Dark Blue on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 20P.

Currently, this route is 4.825 km long, with a total of 10 stations.

History[]

  • S3E3: Earn Island - Crane Island (Line Complete)

Districts Served[]

  • West Metropolis Archipelago
    • Earn Island
    • Decajotine Island
    • Mosaic Island
    • Southeast Island
    • Crane Island

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This line is a branch of Interisland Line, and runs exclusively within West Metropolis Archipelago (WMA) and enhances transportation between Interisland Line and Stadow Line.
  • This line was the second line (after Interisland Line) to run exclusively within WMA. However, as the main line extended to Peckern North (As Arcgo West Island belongs there) in S3E16, this line became the only line to do so.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line is the first line to be established in Season 3.
  • Originally, this line belonged to a branch of Interisland Line, which adopted a "Y-shaped" configuration. However, due to changes in plans, the Y-shaped configuration was split in two, and this line was the result of the split from Interisland Line.
  • Due to a lack of room for laying tracks, the original plan to set a station at Cajotine Island was scrapped. Instead, the station was set at Decajotine Island.
  • This line adopts the Oceanfloor Station design for the first time in Nazca Railway history. Subsequently, Stadow Line also uses this design.
  • The letter "P" in the line number represents "Bypass".
  • As this line runs almost parallel to Peckern Metro's Northland Line, there were speculation that Nazca Railway wanted to merge with Peckern Metro when this line was established.

title: Good Queen Anne Memorial Park
safeHtml:
Good Queen Anne Memorial Park is a park located between Diamond Pool and Halozy in Twenty-Second Continent. It is named after Anne, the first queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Facilities
  • 3 Opening Hours
  • 4 Fun Facts
  • 5 Gallery
  • 6 Citation and References

History[]

The construction of this park aimed to address the lack of recreational facilities in the Halozy and Diamond Pool areas. The naming of this park had several proposals before finally being named after the wise Queen Anne of the United Kingdom. Anne led an ordinary life, but she was open-minded and promoted the overall development of the United Kingdom Parliament, earning widespread affection from the people and the title of "Good" Queen. The last British monarch to receive the title "Good" was Elizabeth I.

  • January 17 2020: Construction of the park began.
  • January 20 2020: The park was completed.

Facilities[]

The park is equipped with various fitness facilities for public use.

  • 4 standard grass football fields
  • 4 hard surface tier-3 tennis courts
  • 16 basketball courts
  • 6 grass bowling lanes
  • 4 volleyball courts
  • Forest park
  • Training swimming pool with stands
  • Central lawn

Opening Hours[]

Generally, the park is open 24 hours a day.

Fun Facts[]

  • Akashi Line Anne Park Station is named after this park.

Fun Facts[]

  • Exits A and B of this station adopts a crowd control pattern due to the construction of two large stadiums near this station. An extra-wide slope is adopted at the two exits, and a fence is used to separate the two sides in order to divert passenger flow to and from the two stadiums under special circumstances. A similar arrangement would be used at Eclipse Fields Station.
  • This Station uses a space 1.7 times larger than normal stations regarding the concourse size, and a dual crowd control system is used for Exits A and B, with the two crowd controls leading to each of the respective Exits A and B and avoiding each other.[2]
  • The Dual Crowd Control System is marked by red and gray stripes on the ground of the concourse. This indicates that passengers leaving the station are meant to walk at the side closer to the edges, whereas passengers entering the station are meant to walk at the inner side closer to the center.[3]
  • The Station Control Room of this station is located at the west side of this station.
  • Assuming a population density of four people per square meter, this station has a total passenger capacity of 100'000 people, including the exits, concourses and platforms.[4]

History[]

  • August 24 2021: This station began services.

Grand Ruin Line was the fifth line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between Grand Ruin and Han River, and had a total of 11 stations. It was established alongside Main Ruin Station on June 8 2013. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description[]

Grand Ruin Line was the only spur line among the District Railway lines in Terracept NR. It traveled at the northeast of the Terracept Continent.

This line was represented by Light Green Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 2A.

At the time of its closure, this route was 9.47 km long, with a total of 11 stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line was established as a spur line of Grand Ruin Line connecting between Grand Ruin and Imperial Ruin. However, after the construction of Oblique Channel at Hartasy Line, this line became a line on its own right and was renamed "Grand Ruin Line". Nevertheless, despite being an independent line, the line number remained unchanged.
  • According to the line system map at Terracept Terminal, this line had plans to extend one more station from Han River station, but it never came to fruition due to the closure of Terracept Division.

History[]

  • June 8 2013: Grand Ruin - Imperial Ruin
  • July 31 2014: Grand Ruin - Han River

Fun Facts[]

  • This station was not recorded on the Online Map of Project Nazca until December 29 2021, 445 days after the completion of this station.
  • This station is the second station after Purity Corner Station to adopt bricks inside the station structure.
  • As Oasis Bay Line will go to the Archipelago at Strait of Freedom in the future, the structure of this station is dug deeper than other Underground Stations. However, as this station is still a sizable distance from the coastline of Jupiter, the depth of this station would not have to be too deep.[3]

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0.5
  • Look around at the East Station Park. If you find a hole, jump inside it.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of grass.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Coop?
    • Friends?

Fun Facts[]

  • While this station was originally planned to be an Elevated Station, it ultimately became a ground station due to the following factors:
    • Having an elevated station in this area would affect the villagers at the naturally spawned Village between Flask East Checkpoint and this station due to noise pollution.
    • At the time of this station's construction, the plans of Stadium Line crossing Splended River would involve an undersea tunnel, and the height change involved from an elevated station to an undersea tunnel would be too large.
  • This station alludes to Tsuen Wan Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.

History[]

  • May 9 2015: This station began services.
  • March 25 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[6]
  • February 22 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[7]
  • June 20 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[8]
  • April 26 2020: The section between this station and Kong Corner completed elevatization works.[9]
  • July 25 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up alongside a new station park to the west.[10]
  • January 17 2023: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[11]
